title: German Noodle Dish
description: A simple yet hearty German noodle dish made with a nutty flavor. This dish is inspired by traditional German cuisine.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the noodles according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, cook the sliced sausage over medium heat until browned.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the chopped chinese dish to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the nutty dish and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Drain the cooked noodles and add them to the skillet.
Toss the noodles with the sausage and vegetable mixture until well combined.
